textos.texto: Ana studies computer science at the university. The campus is far from her house, so she takes the metro every morning. She has five subjects this semester: maths, history, science, English and computer science. Her first class is at eight in a small classroom near the library. Ana loves maths, because it is difficult but it is not the same every day. History is easy for her, but she does not like it. In her bag there is a notebook with her notes, a dictionary and her computer. She has all her notes from the class, because she does not understand all the class. After the class she practises the difficult questions in the library with her classmates. Ana has a scholarship, so she does not pay for the university. She must pass all her exams: with a good grade the scholarship is for all her degree. In December there are exams for every subject. Ana does not want to fail: she wants to graduate in four years and teach computer science.

textos.texto: On Monday Paul has a maths exam at nine in the big classroom of the campus. Maths is a very difficult subject for him: he does not understand the questions and he never has good grades. This semester he practises every day with Lee, a classmate. Lee is very good at maths and he teaches Paul in the library. Why is this answer not good? Paul has many questions and Lee has the answers. Before the exam Paul reads all his notes and he learns the difficult things. On Monday he is in the classroom at half past eight, with two pens and his notebook. The exam is not easy: there are twenty questions and one hour. Paul understands sixteen questions, so he does not fail: his grade is good and he passes. He is very happy, because with this grade he does not have a problem in the semester. Now he must learn history and science too.

textos.texto: Laura studies history at the university and she loves her degree. Her campus is in the city centre, near the museum, so she goes on foot. This semester she has four subjects: history, English, science and maths. Maths is very difficult for her and she does not understand the classes, so she practises with a classmate every Tuesday. Her teacher of history is very good: she teaches with films and with old books, and the classes are never long. In her classroom there are thirty classmates and every one has a computer. Laura has a big notebook for her notes and a dictionary in English. When she does not understand a question, she reads the dictionary or she has the answer from her teacher. Laura wants to teach history in a school, so she must graduate with good grades. She does not have a scholarship: her parents pay for the university. In June she has three exams. History is easy for her, but she does not want to fail maths.

textos.texto: Lee wants a scholarship for computer science. It is for the students with good grades in all the subjects. Lee is in his second semester and he has five subjects: maths, science, computer science, English and history. Maths and computer science are easy for him, because he practises every day with his computer. English is very difficult: he does not understand the classes and he has a dictionary in his bag all the day. Ana teaches him English in the library on Wednesday: she has the questions and Lee must have the answers. Why is this difficult for him? Lee does not learn the language in the classroom: he must listen to music and watch films in English. In December he has six exams. He must not fail one: with a small grade there is no scholarship. Lee passes all the exams and he has the scholarship for all his degree. Now he wants to graduate and teach computer science in his university.

textos.texto: Marie studies science at the university. The campus is near her house, so she goes on foot every morning. This semester she has four subjects: science, maths, history and English. Her first class is at nine in a big classroom next to the library. Science is easy for her, because she practises every day, but maths is very difficult: she does not understand the questions of her teacher. On Tuesday a classmate teaches her in the library: Marie has the questions and he has the answers. In her bag there is a notebook with her notes, a dictionary and a book of history. Marie does not have a scholarship, so she works in a café on Saturday. In June there are exams for every subject. She must not fail: with good grades she can graduate in three years. Then she wants to teach science in a school. Her degree is difficult, but for Marie it is not a problem.
